assumptions: A Flipkart-size store: about 2,000 orders a minute at ₹1,847 each, from yearly GMV of ₹1.75–2.1 lakh crore
About 2% of Indian mobile shopping sessions end in an order, so that is about 100,000 sessions a minute, each worth about ₹37
About 8% of sessions are lost to crashes and slow pages during the restart loop (our estimate)
A typical manual fix for a memory leak takes about 90 minutes with 2 engineers paged (our estimate)
An engineer costs about ₹1,070 an hour: the median Bengaluru SRE pay of ₹20.5 lakh a year over about 1,920 working hours (salary only; benefits and tools would add more)
